notes.title: MicroProse Joins the Journey!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43675061/5741c2bce0ef00a0c73c570750e6c40caf06fd61.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! We’ve got some HUGE news to share with you—[b]MicroProse is now officially publishing Conur Life! [/b]
This partnership means even bigger things for the game, and we couldn’t be more excited for what’s ahead. If you love classic open-world crime games with a unique twist, you’re in for a treat!

[b][h2]New Content & Updates[/h2][/b]
We’ve been hard at work improving Conur Life, and we’re thrilled to introduce a massive update packed with fresh content and exciting enhancements:
[list]
[*] [b]39 New Missions[/b] – More chaos, more action, and more ways to make your mark on San Hugo.
[*] [b]Revamped Combat System[/b] – Better enemy AI, improved gunplay, and new boss mechanics.
[*] [b]New Weapons[/b] – Say hello to the Minigun and Flamethrower—perfect for turning up the heat in the streets.
[*] [b]Expanded World[/b] – Explore six new neighborhoods, each with its own personality and challenges.
[*] [b]Fresh Soundtrack[/b] – Enjoy brand-new radio stations featuring an awesome mix of Argentine music.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43675061/61043d9b3acc2026578c380793bb6da103364414.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43675061/c04acde34efae7048f8fe63f12bbadc4a0d5820b.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Thank You to Our Amazing Community![/h2][/b]
We want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you who has supported Conur Life so far. Your feedback, playtime, and enthusiasm have helped shape the game into what it is today. Whether you've been with us since the beginning or are just discovering the world of San Hugo, we appreciate you more than we can say.

We can’t wait for you to jump in, explore the latest updates, and let us know what you think. As always, keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for even more surprises in the future!

See you in San Hugo!

- The Conur Life Team

notes.title: STORY MODE (Only in spanish for now)
notes.notes:
Story mode or campaign mode is now available!

Alexis, a neighborhood boy indebted to one of the most important gangsters in San Hugo, goes through a violent journey that involves facing complex situations about ethics and morality, together with different partners who will accompany him in this difficult struggle that comes with living in San Hugo.

notes.title: New update: Sounds and more.
notes.notes:
- New sound effects for: Gun, MP5, explosions, Fn-Fal, Ithaca, bullet impacts on cars, surfaces and people, car crashes, destruction of objects and car doors.
- HUD order changes.
- Added Dash/Roll (Pressing Space).
- New code: "caosextremo". (Survive the chaos, if you can)
- Secret tank (Find it if you can).

notes.title: Assorted changes!
notes.notes:
Alpha 1.1.3
- New mechanic: Dash/Roll (Pressing space)
- Sparks when hitting the bullets against objects.
- More visible blood (redder and larger).
- Cops now always get out of the police car when chasing you.
- NPCS turn red when taking damage.
- Weapon recoil animation slightly changed
- UI sound change.
- Added exhaust pipe smoke to cars.
- Added car wheel marks when braking.
- General bug fixes.

notes.title: Graphic update
notes.notes:
I updated the lighting engine of Conur Life from the conventional one, to the Universal Pipeline system (Lights 2D) so that the lights look much more beautiful, as well as added a better post processing, and a change in the textures of the grass / grass .

notes.title: Working in the Story Mode
notes.notes:
How are you doing? I wanted to tell you that I am working on the Story Mode and that it will probably be available for April or May, I am trying to create an interesting story with the odd twist, it will be short but I prefer that, rather than take time to deliver a longer version.

I hope you are liking the game, I did it with a lot of love since I knew absolutely nothing, until today when I defend myself a little more.

By the way, I know that some people the game may run slowly, despite being a pixelart, do not forget that it is not fully optimized since I am still new to this, and that the game beyond being pixelart has many codes, Most of which are running in real time so that the npc interact, the city in general has life, etc.

I leave you a little preview of the story mode :D
